stem: At a Massachusetts pharmacy, a pharmacist directly oversees sterile and complex nonsterile compounding. Select all supported conclusions.

choices.text: In this setting, the applicable sterile-compounding CE requirement must be met annually.

At this stage, the applicable complex-nonsterile compounding CE requirement must also be assessed.
For this scenario, compounding CE applies only to technicians.
Given the described event, sterile and complex-nonsterile compounding duties are cumulative when both activities are supervised.
